slices.title: Tail-first paged ListConversation across planes (conditional)
slices.summary: Adds opt-in tail-first paging to the transcript read across session-core, model-gateway and the BFF: add-only ListConversationRequest.limit=6 and before_message_id=7 with ListConversationResponse.has_more=2, a clamped query that keeps audience_ceiling in the same WHERE, and validated limit and before forwarding. limit=0 (the default) keeps every other caller byte-identical; no migration; conditional per D5.
slices.remaining: Conditional (WS09 D5) on WS09-S1 long-thread numbers; DEC-29 fixes the cursor (before_message_id) if it is built. WS17-S8 treats it as a soft rebase, not a dependency.
